title: A map fixing N near x has derivative equal to the identity on tangentSpace N x
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, N, O ⊆ ℝ^P with O open, π : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and x ∈ O. Assume π is (Fréchet) differentiable at x and π(z) = z for all z ∈ N ∩ O. Then Dπ(x)v = v for every v ∈ tangentSpace N x, i.e. for every v = γ′(0) where γ : ℝ → ℝ^P is C¹ on (−1, 1), γ((−1, 1)) ⊆ N and γ(0) = x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (N O : Set (Euclid P)) (proj : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), IsOpen O → x ∈ O → DifferentiableAt ℝ proj x → (∀ z ∈ N ∩ O, proj z = z) → ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace N x, fderiv ℝ proj x v = v
